mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the gland and sensory endings made the layered skin more than a barrier: the planned cutaway locates the coil, pore and nerves and connects them to skin function.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to join the epidermis directly to connective tissue was confusing: the need to add vessels first was not apparent from the layer descriptions.

surprise.text: I expected the two skin layers to combine directly, but the dermis first needed blood vessels; inspecting it revealed and automatically performed that preparation.

arbitrary.text: Requiring vascularization before the layers could join felt like an unexplained ordering constraint, although vessels have a clear nourishing role in the finished skin.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: assembling the structures and seeing their functional connections was useful, though I would want clearer cues for hidden ordering requirements. The picture descriptions are plans, so they cannot establish how well students would understand the finished illustrations.
